_about: WHO MAY BE LISTED to people (RULINGS 2026-10-17). One decision per catalog dataset, made by a person, read by tools/gen-catalog.py (--listing). A dataset with no entry is an error, never listed by default. Two guards in the generator and in catalog_rules.ts catch a listable:true whose licence or notes say INTERNAL, BY-SA, non-commercial and so on, or whose licence names no open licence.
decided_by: ENGINE proposal from the registry licence text, 2026-10-17; the not-listable entries need Ryan or CC1 to confirm or overturn
